title: ClimateSummary
description: Canonical contract for normalized NASA Earth Observation and Climate Data Engine outputs in AgroShift (Module 02).

farm_id.description: Unique identifier of the farm from Module 01 FarmProfile.

source.description: Originating source organization or API (e.g., NASA POWER API).

product_or_dataset.description: Underlying satellite, model, or reanalysis product (e.g., MERRA-2 / GEOS-5 FP-IT / CERES SYN1deg via POWER AG community).

latitude.description: Latitude coordinate in decimal degrees (-90 to 90).

longitude.description: Longitude coordinate in decimal degrees (-180 to 180).

start_date.description: Start of observed window in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD).

end_date.description: End of observed window in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD).

parameters.description: List of environmental parameters included with exact codes, human labels, and SI/agricultural units.

daily_series.description: Optional chronological daily observation records for detailed charting and time-series analysis.

retrieved_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of when data was retrieved or synthesized.

coverage_note.description: Explicit provenance disclosure clarifying that data represents regional satellite/reanalysis grid cells rather than on-farm sensors.

is_demo_data.description: Flag indicating if the summary was generated from synthetic/mock fixtures rather than live NASA API calls.

code.description: Exact NASA POWER parameter identifier (e.g., T2M, PRECTOTCORR, RH2M, ALLSKY_SFC_SW_DWN).

label.description: Descriptive human-readable name of the parameter.

unit.description: Official standard unit of measurement (e.g., °C, mm/day, %, MJ/m^2/day).

values.description: Parameter code to numeric value mapping. Unobserved or missing values must be null (never 0 or fabricated).

seasonal.description: Agro-ecological season aggregated statistics (e.g. Kharif, Rabi).

aggregation_method.description: Method of aggregation applied (e.g., mean for T2M, sum for PRECTOTCORR).

values.description: Metric values per parameter (mean, sum, min, max).

season.description: Season name (e.g., Kharif, Rabi, Spring, Annual).

period.description: Date range span of season (e.g., 2024-05 to 2024-10).

aggregation_method.description: Method of aggregation applied across the seasonal window.

total_days.description: Total calendar days spanned by start_date to end_date.

missing_days_by_parameter.description: Count of missing observations (sentinel -999 mapped to null) per parameter.

has_gaps.description: True if any parameter has at least one missing observation day.

notes.description: Human-readable notes regarding missing data or sensor outages.

error_code.description: Standardized uppercase error code (e.g. INVALID_COORDINATES, UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT).

message.description: Human-readable description of what failed and how to remediate.

details.description: Optional arbitrary dictionary or list providing contextual debugging clues.

request_id.description: Optional tracing or correlation ID for the request.
